before.interpretation: Each counter is interval-union occupancy per time bin, across a rank's streams within one category. Categories overlap and must not be summed as GPU utilization. No individual kernels or arrows. Counters are rounded to 0.01 percentage points; sub-bin gaps are averaged. Full dependency records remain in the capture archives.

checks.scope: CPU conversion cache only; CUDA scheduling and complete outputs require separate native validation.

limitations: Cache retains 2,836,681,856 bytes of extra CPU tensors. This is a host-memory-for-CPU-time tradeoff, not a free optimization.
GX host CPU is EPYC 7702P; A100 validation host CPU is EPYC 9554. Calibration is not matched to native CPU hardware.
GX CPU calibration has 9,339 resolved and 2,594 unresolved samples (21.74% unresolved).

Mode 2 predicted launch inventories match; ten unpredicted cuDNN transform launches have differing malformed dimensions. Mode 3 also selects different cuDNN plans, with 10 versus 40 misses. Missing launches receive no predicted service; coverage by launch count is not time coverage.
GX overestimates the native reduction. Native timings drift across ABBA process groups; all samples and both mean and median are retained.

Single prompt, seed, shape, unquantized checkpoint and ordinary CPU offload. Training, arbitrary streams, direct .data mutation, concurrent weight mutation, and arbitrary ComfyUI graphs are not validated.

The initial native kernel calibration used no_grad; the selected timing experiment uses inference_mode. Calibration report peak_gpu_bytes covers only the post-reset VAE phase; selected reports preserve peaks across all internal resets.
Physical GPU1 was idle before validation; unrelated GPU0 work may share host resources.

reproduction.note: Adjust host and asset paths; apply patch to pinned Wrapper source. Reuses the existing native kernel database. Shared GX worker launcher and audit helpers live in this repository.
